description: This file defines the internal sealed class `ReminderTableGrain`, which implements reminder table management within Orleans runtime using grain persistence and in-memory data structures. It includes methods for reading, updating, removing reminders, and handles grain migration.

classes.name: ReminderTableGrain
classes.description: A grain class managing reminder entries in-memory, supporting CRUD operations and migration callbacks within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles the grain activation event, initializing state.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the in-memory reminder table, for testing purposes.

methods.name: ReadRows (GrainId grainId)
methods.description: Reads all reminder entries for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows (uint begin, uint end)
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Fetches a specific reminder for a grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry and assigns a new ETag.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder entry if ETag matches.

methods.name: IGrainMigrationParticipant.OnDehydrate
methods.description: Prepares the reminder table for migration by adding it to dehydration context.

methods.name: IGrainMigrationParticipant.OnRehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the reminder table from migration context.
